description: Land Title Settlement Dept - Doranuwa, Ruwanwella D/S/D, kegalle District (25/14-204-0069)
categorisation: The gazette content is exclusively focused on the formal registration and declaration of land titles for specific parcels of land under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a detailed schedule listing parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and encumbrances. This falls squarely under the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4), which cover land registrations, property ownership, and title settlements. There is no mention of government personnel changes, portfolio assignments, or any other subject matter that would trigger the higher-priority government-related classifications (Types 1-3).
